Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
To get started with Cozey, everything is designed to be straightforward:
Fit and delivery: Our sofas are modular and ship in multiple smaller boxes (on average around 30 inches in length, width, and height), making them easy to fit through standard doorways and hallways.
Assembly: No special tools are needed. Step-by-step PDF instructions and video guides are available on our Assembly Guides page and YouTube.
30-Day Risk-Free Trial: From the day your order arrives, you have 30 days to test it in your space. If it’s not the right fit, returns are completely free—just be sure to keep all the original packaging.
Free Design Help: If you’d like support choosing fabrics, configurations, or visualizing your layout before ordering, you can schedule a free Design Consultation (available via phone, video call, or in-person at our Toronto Flagship Store).

What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?
All Cozey items, including rugs, come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them.
Here are the key details:
Free returns: If it’s not the right fit for your space, you can return it completely free of charge within the 30-day window, provided the items are returned in their original packaging.
Keep the original packaging: Missing boxes or significant damage may result in a fee. If original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing boxes (up to a maximum of $150) will be deducted from your refund. (Note: For mattresses, which have a 100-night trial, original packaging does not need to be kept).
How to start a return: You can initiate a return through our Self-Service Portal by logging into your account.
Refund processing: Once our Quality Assurance Team receives and inspects the item to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications, your refund will be processed within 3–7 business days.
